description: Read one engineering pattern's full Markdown from patterns/<id>/PATTERN.md, including frontmatter, rules, and a counterexample. Use it for the practice behind an NF rule; do not use it to enumerate patterns (pattern_list) or read domain modules (module_read). pattern_id is the exact, case-sensitive directory name such as fail-closed-verification, not the document title. A missing pattern is an error, not an empty result; reads one local file and returns its full text without truncation. Local-only; no auth or rate limits.

pattern_id.description: Exact pattern directory name (for example fail-closed-verification or single-source-truth).

name: pattern_read

outputSchema.description: A pattern file with its metadata and full Markdown body.

found.description: True when the pattern was located.

text.description: Full PATTERN.md body as stored on disk.

title: Read engineering pattern
